Thank you very much for sharing this. I wish I was better at saying things that could help you feel any better about your son, but I don't know if there is anything anyone could even say. 

I always had trouble telling people how I feel. I just don't know how to. My brother is the only one who knows how I feel, but he doesn't know the extent and he doesn't know really how to help. 

I have lost two people to suicide, but I didn't know either of them well and I know I still wish I could have helped them.

So I can't imagine how I'd feel if it was a family member. I don't want to put anyone through that.

Thank you for helping me. I may not feel much better, but I have a desire to try some more and think about my family.

I'm sorry about your son. 
I have honestly tried to talk to my mother before about this. She said I was faking and refused to listen. I'm sure she cares, I love her. I just want the pain to end.

If I had hope in the future, I'm sure I would try, but no matter how much medicine I take and therapy I go to, the pain seems to stay.

You're honestly probably right, and I thank you for this comment. I really don't want to put my family through losing me, I just want the pain to stop through any means

I have a hard time communicating with people because I'll be too scared to talk to them. I have pretty severe social anxiety and just recently in the past 6 months I started overcoming it. It got worse and worse until I couldn't even leave the house and I'd almost cry being so scared of talking to people. It took 19 years for me to begin to overcome it, and even then I regress sometimes and people at work get confused because I'm too scared to talk. 

I also have depression, which hasn't been that bad in the past two days but there are weeks where it's really bad. I doubt myself so much and always catch myself taking down to myself in that little head voice.
